QUOTATIONS.Definition: short pieces of text repeated from what someone said or wrote

INTRIGUING.Definition: very interesting because it is unusual or mysterious

BAN.Definition: officially not allow; (as a noun) an official order that stops something

PROHIBITION.Definition: an official decision that something is not allowed

SMUGGLED.Definition: taken or brought secretly and illegally

CENSORSHIP.Definition: official control of what people are allowed to read or see

ELITE.Definition: a small group of people with the most power

BOARD.Definition: a group of people who officially manage an organisation

A BADGE OF SHAME.Definition: something that gives someone a bad reputation

REGIMES.Definition: governments, especially ones that control people strictly and unfairly

APARTHEID.Definition: the former system in South Africa of separating races and treating black people unfairly

UNAPPETISING.Definition: unpleasant and not at all attractive

EXCEPTIONS.Definition: cases where the usual rule does not apply

CORRELATION.Definition: a connection between two things, where one changes as the other does

PROPHECY.Definition: a statement about what will happen in the future

PROPORTION.Definition: a part or share of a whole group

INDULGENCES.Definition: papers sold by the Catholic Church that promised to free people from punishment for sins

FORMS.Definition: printed papers with empty spaces for writing information

FORGIVENESS.Definition: a promise that someone would no longer be blamed or punished

THESES.Definition: written statements of ideas or arguments

NAILED.Definition: fixed with small metal pins hit in with a hammer

CLERGY.Definition: priests and other people who lead religious services

LITERACY.Definition: the ability to read and write

SPREAD.Definition: share widely; (as a past form) shared widely

BENEFICIARIES.Definition: people who gain an advantage from something

UNORTHODOX.Definition: different from what is usual or accepted

OVERLAP.Definition: share some of the same parts or features; (as a noun) the shared part

DISSENT.Definition: disagreement with official ideas or with those in power

FLED.Definition: ran away to a safer place

GULAG.Definition: a Soviet prison camp where people were forced to do hard work

BADGE OF HONOUR.Definition: a sign of importance or respect

EXPLICIT.Definition: showing or describing things clearly and in detail

BOARDS.Definition: groups of people who are in charge of an organisation

PROSECUTED.Definition: officially accused of a crime in court

OBSCENITY.Definition: publishing something shocking and offensive, especially about sex

MORALS.Definition: beliefs about what is right and wrong behaviour

PROSECUTION.Definition: the side in a trial that tries to prove someone is guilty

JURY.Definition: a group of ordinary people who decide a court case

SKYROCKETED.Definition: rose very quickly by a large amount

DEGENERACY.Definition: a decline into bad or unacceptable behaviour

CENSORS.Definition: officials who decide what can be published or shown

NARRATOR.Definition: a character who tells the story

CULT.Definition: loved very much by a particular group of fans

CURRICULUMS.Definition: lists of subjects and books taught in a school

URBAN MYTH.Definition: a story that many people believe but that is probably not true

THEOCRATIC.Definition: ruled by religious leaders or religious law

BLASPHEMOUS.Definition: showing no respect for God or holy things

PROPHET.Definition: a person believed to be sent by God to teach people

DISTRIBUTED.Definition: shared out; given to many people
